bottom_line: The power and grid ratings mostly still hold tonight. Futures are higher (Nasdaq 100 about +1.4%) on CoreWeave's beat, but Tuesday's hot CPI realised the worldview's top risk, so start small. Don't chase a gap-up at the open; a bounce driven by one earnings report can fade with the 10-year near 5%.

No AI chip or data-centre earnings tonight; Cisco and Applied Materials report Thursday after the close.
